services.name: Fishing Report
services.desc: Offshore fishing continues to be excellent here on the Outer Banks, with bluefin tuna still providing exciting action for anglers heading offshore with Fishin Fannatic. Over the past several weeks, we have seen strong catches of quality bluefin tuna, and the bite remains consistent as we move deeper into spring. These powerful fish are giving anglers unforgettable fights and making every trip offshore an exciting experience. In addition to the steady bluefin action, we are now starting to see the first yellowfin tuna of the season showing up offshore.
